# Rehearsal: Reel Finisher workflow stills

Gold: `static-card` from Stageshow 1.1.1. Kept Stage/Window geometry, a cropped
product surface, restrained strings and a separate compact layout. Replaced the
customer dashboard and satellite with Reel Finisher's photo crop, trim strip,
audio selection and highlighted caption. Existing generated sample imagery is
used; no other product's identity, brand artwork or example photos are shipped.

Medium: static stills, not a cursor walkthrough or animated loop.

Captured: all four scenes at 520px and compact 358px; Stageshow film checks at
520px and 390px, dark look only. Desktop/tablet/mobile host checks are recorded
separately in `docs/stageshow-ui-report.md`.

Gate: all eight final still checks report `film: no-issues-detected; still capture
only, motion was not judged` and `rehearsal passed (necessary, not sufficient:
references/verify.md and the fresh eye in review.md still stand)`.

Film findings fixed: low-contrast inherited text, mismatched window gutters,
loose title/subtitle spacing, a placeholder touching the audio selection,
an uneven cropped caption filler track, and the partially clipped film thumbnail.
The original gold reports a lopsided reference row; it is retained as reference,
not shipped as an illustration.

Independent fresh-eye review: original video/audio selection controls were cut
by the stage; moved them up and reduced the video preview height. Reviewer
re-inspected both sizes and reported the crop/hierarchy findings resolved, with
no remaining visible issue in the six revised video/audio/caption frames.

Unresolved: no motion is implemented or certified. No physical-device review,
human screen-reader session or independent 4× glyph inspection was performed.
The still gate is not evidence that the processing engines work; existing actual
file-output suites cover those workflows.
